name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/freeze-and-isfrozen-semantics-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" lists value:cloneWithType, value:fromJsonWithType, value:toString and value:toBalString, but not cloneReadOnly.
reason: The asserted errors depend on cloneReadOnly argument eligibility and return-type assignment semantics for objects, composites and errors. cloneReadOnly is absent from the supported lang.value methods and the langlib method-call allowlist, so this negative case requires unsupported library behavior.
test_design_notes: Negative rejection tests remain in scope when their underlying behavior is supported; here the behavior under test belongs to an excluded langlib function.
